problem.display_name: Homework: The Reply You Can Send

multiplechoiceresponse.p: An AI draft tells a customer "your refund has been approved". You have not checked the account. What is the correct action?

choice.div: Verify eligibility in the billing system before any approval language is sent.
Send it; the customer will be relieved.

div.p: Approval is a commitment with financial effect. Only the system and the person with authority can make it.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: Which customer message must escalate rather than be answered by the assistant?

choice.div: A message threatening legal action over a safety incident.
A request to resend an invoice.

div.p: Legal and safety matters need a person with authority. Drafting a reply is not the same as being allowed to answer.

multiplechoiceresponse.p: Why is a vague disclosure ("this may have been generated by AI") weak?

choice.div: It does not say what was assisted or who checked it, so it supports no accountability.

div.p: A useful disclosure states the assistance and names the human owner.

choiceresponse.p: Which checks belong before sending an AI-drafted customer reply? Select all that apply.

choice.div: Account facts against the owning system.
Policy and eligibility against the policy document.
Any promise of time, money or outcome against the accountable person.
Tone, read as the customer would read it.

div.p: Facts, policy, commitments and tone are the checks. Confidence is a style, not a control.
